Question: I am am 22 year old student and hanfi my q is that ihav come across so many sahih hadith in witch this is proven that prophet (saw)did the rafia dain as in sahih albukhari and in a book of hanfi fiqh its written that rafia dain is authentic and none of them is mansookh(faizul bari2\225)moreover imam abu hanifa(ra)himself said that if u find any hadith to b authentic then that is my madhab(rasmul muti p4) but when i do rafia dain becos my beloved prophet(saw) did the same some aalims of my city says that dont do this it has been mansookh can u plzz give me just one sahih hadith that rafia dain is mansokh. Answer ID: 7067 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1598/1361=B/1429) It is better (afzal) not to raise hands while going to rukoo and rising from it. The strongest Hadith free from every weakness and defect in this regard is: عن سالم عن ابیہ قال رایت رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم اذا افتتح الصلوۃ رفع یدیہ حتی یحاذی بھما، وقال بعضھم: حذاء منکبیہ، و اذا اراد ان یرکع و بعد ما یرفع راسہ من الرکوع لایرفعھما، وقال بعضھم: ولا یرفع بین السجدتین، والمعنی واحد ( مسند الحمیدی 2:277، صحیح ابی عوانۃ 90 ) Besides, the Hanafis preferred this for action since the Four Caliphs used to do so. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
